title: Remainder and Factor Theorems
summary: Dividing by (x − a), the remainder theorem, the factor theorem, and factorising cubics.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Manjari (2026): Exploring Algebraic Identities (factorisation; the remainder and factor theorems are only in the earlier book)

objectives: I can find the remainder when p(x) is divided by (x − a).
I can use the factor theorem to test factors.
misconceptions: A remainder of 0 means the quotient is 0.
